There are several ways to save for college, including setting aside a portion of your part-time job earnings, exploring scholarship opportunities, and considering a 529 college savings plan. personal_stories.summary: Investing in a Roth IRA can be a great way to save for retirement and potentially reduce your tax liability. With a Roth IRA, you contribute after-tax dollars, which can then be invested and grow tax-free. As a high school student, this could mean setting aside a portion of your part-time job earnings or exploring other investment opportunities.
personal_stories.fullContent:
Investing in a Roth IRA can be a great way to save for retirement and potentially reduce your tax liability. With a Roth IRA, you contribute after-tax dollars, which can then be invested and grow tax-free. This means that you won't have to pay taxes on the investment earnings, which can help your savings grow faster.

How Roth IRAs Work

A Roth IRA is a type of retirement account that allows you to contribute after-tax dollars, which can then be invested and grow tax-free. The funds in a Roth IRA can be used to pay for qualified retirement expenses, such as living expenses and healthcare costs. Roth IRAs are subject to income limits and contribution limits, so it's essential to understand the rules and regulations before investing.

The contribution limit for a Roth IRA in 2026 is $6,000 per year.

Action Step

Consider consulting with a financial advisor to learn more about Roth IRAs and how they can help you achieve your long-term financial goals. You can also explore other investment opportunities, such as stocks or mutual funds, to help you get started.
